measures.title: Walker County: senior property tax exemption (Act 2026-15)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Walker County. It would let a qualified taxpayer age 65 or older claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions.
measures.yesMeans: Qualified Walker County taxpayers 65 or older could claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and this senior exemption does not take effect.

measures.title: Walker County: maximum qualifying age for judge of probate (Act 2026-31)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Walker County. It would set the maximum age at which a person may qualify as judge of probate of the county at 75 years at the time of qualifying for election or appointment.
measures.yesMeans: A person could qualify as Walker County judge of probate up to age 75 at the time of qualifying for election or appointment.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and the current age rule for judge of probate stays in place.
